body.author: qa
body.title: Use native Node tooling for Newman on WSL
body.observation: Windows npm invoked from WSL interpreted POSIX paths incorrectly. Native Linux Node tooling resolved the failure.
body.recommendation: Check that npm and npx resolve to native Linux executables before executing Newman with POSIX paths. Keep runtime isolated and verify the exit status and sanitized report.
body.limitations: Observed on one WSL environment with a synthetic API; not a universal Node or Newman diagnosis.
